The TypeScript package's recorded Stats answers, for the parity test of this
package (tests/test_stats_ts_answers.py).

These files are bca-mcp-ts test/fixtures/stats_api as of its commit ef30a7a
(unchanged at 94db344), copied unchanged: answers/, expected_outputs/,
shards/, SHA256SUMS and README.md. Their README says how they were made: a
made-up night folder run through the design's reference script, and expected
outputs written from the reference rules, not from either package's code.
Every address is 0x plus the leading 40 hex characters of SHA-256 of
bca-fixture-<n>, and no address or vault name is from the real files.

This package's own set stays in tests/fixtures/stats_api. When the API's
dump (task A1, scripts/dump_stats_answers.py) is copied into both packages,
it replaces both sets.
